description: Create a centralized error handling and validation middleware layer for server functions. Currently, 160+ `throw new Error()` statements and 102 try-catch blocks are scattered across 19 server files with inconsistent error messages. Implement a custom error class hierarchy (e.g., `AppError`, `AuthorizationError`, `ValidationError`) and a decorator/wrapper for server functions that provides consistent error handling, logging, and client-safe error responses.
